{{Quote|Corellian ale... in a clean glass.|[[Kyle Katarn]]|audio=CorellianAle.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>}}
'''Corellian ale''' was a popular [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage brewed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It also came in a [[Corellian spiced ale|spiced variety]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Ah, Corellian ale. How wonderful.|[[Ados Jarkey]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
[[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Ale/Legends|ale]] had a sweet flavor and medium weight body. It was possibly the most common alcholic beverage in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWG" /> Corellian ale was purple in coloration.<ref name="Rancor" />

==History==
{{Quote|I need to know if I can suck down more Corellian ale than a bantha. Problem is, I haven't yet found a bantha that drinks. Does that mean I win by default?|[[Jonset]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
[[Kyle Katarn]] was one of many who would drink [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Ale/Legends|ale]] (though he would insist that it be served in a clean glass).<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast" />

While supervising [[Cann Doon]] unloading his [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] cargo outside [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], [[Bidlo Kwerve/Legends|Bidlo Kwerve]] indulged in drinking Corellian ale. He was sipping his sixth when the unloading was interrupted by the arrival of a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]].<ref name="Rancor" />

[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] shared a mutual appreciation for the drink, which contributed to their becoming close friends while members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] ordered Corellian ale while dining in the [[Riverview Café]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Varlo]]<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> world [[Roonadan]].<ref name="Ascension" />

[[Cade Skywalker]] ordered a "Corellian" at [[Rik's Cantina/Legends|Rik's Cantina]]. When asked to specify ale or [[Corellian whiskey/Legends|Corellian whiskey]], he requested both. [[Jool]] then put the tab on the house.

==Behind the scenes==
This drink was also known as '[[Juri juice/Legends|Juri juice]]' in the PlayStation [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace''.

Corellian ale appeared in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the game, Corellian ale could be purchased from [[Bartender/Legends|bartenders]] in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It should be noted that the same graphical model for Corellian ale was used for other [[:w:c:swg:Item|items]] in the game.
